lines.t: Look at the photos, don't I look bright?
High school halls and electric light
I'm winning the games, I'm leading the pack
Finally walking a road that won't turn me back
Is it in the friends that I found?
They say I'm the best
I finally feel like I've passed the test
Building my house on warm golden sand
I'm happy, I'm really okay
Please don't ask me to stay
The smiles are worth the price that I paid
What did it cost?
I'm not empty, I'm finally free
I can't feel in anything
Hiding from the girl I used to be
Everything is magic, everything is gold
It's getting so cold
At least that's the story I'm being told
The holidays change but the lights are so pretty
I found a new pulse in the heart of the city
They love me for me, you're the girl that I play
Nobody's asking me why I don't pray
It's better this way, it's easy to breathe
When belief is a cold that you quietly leave
I'm freezing
Is this what they meant by the best years of life?
Crying in bathrooms under fluorescent light
If I say it enough, maybe it's true
If I let her fade, she won't follow you
I'm okay, I'm okay, I'm okay
Then the silence spoke louder than all of the noise
I heard the soft echo of a father's voice
I looked in the mirror and finally saw
The sand was all shifting, I'm breaking the fall
I threw off the coat that I wore as a lie
I'm tired of acting, I'm ready to fly
The void isn't empty, it's where you stepped in
To finish the story, I try to begin
I'm happy I'm finally okay
No more price to pay
The smile is real cause you washed it away
You washed the guilty away
I'm not empty, I'm finally free
I'm who I'm meant to be
Running to the girl I used to be
Everything is mercy, everything is grace
I can see your face
This is the story I want to embrace
Can we have peace?
I didn't lose you
You were waiting for me at home
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
